name: Speed Factory Indoor Karting
address: 130 East Daniel Morgan Ave, Spartanburg, SC

booking.howItWorks: Fill in the event enquiry form on the website (location, dates, event type, age range, group size) or call the track; the team follows up to plan the party.

packages.name: Party / Group Event
packages.description: Birthday parties, team building, corporate events, graduations, bachelor & bachelorette parties, fundraisers, church groups and more. Hospitality areas and private rooms available. Contact for pricing.

packages.name: Exclusive Facility Rental
packages.description: Exclusive rental of the entire facility for private events, available 7 days a week. Contact guest services for pricing.

faq.a: After arriving you will need to provide proof of identity, attend a safety briefing and kart orientation, and then get ready to race. All karts are identical. Every lap is timed and you receive a printout of your lap times and finishing position. Each race includes a DOT approved full face helmet, balaclava (head sock) and neck brace.

faq.q: What are the requirements to drive?
faq.a: Drivers 16 yrs & older between 4'6" - 7'0", and under 300 lbs, can drive in all open sessions. Drivers under 18 yrs old must have signed parental approval and state issued drivers license.

faq.q: What do I have to wear?
faq.a: Closed toe shoes, full face DOT approved helmet, head sock (balaclava) and neck brace. Long hair must be tied in a pony tail and placed up inside the helmet. Personal full face DOT approved helmets are allowed; motocross helmets are allowed with goggles.

Yes, parties are our specialty. We have hospitality areas that can hold groups over 250 people, and private rooms available for any special occasion. We have handled parties with groups from 2 to 275 people.

faq.q: Can we rent the entire facility?
faq.a: Yes, exclusive rental of the entire facility is available 7 days a week. Contact our guest services team to plan your event.
Two locations: Downtown Spartanburg, 130 E Daniel Morgan Ave, 864.447.4000 (one and two seater karts); Greenville, 1524 Roper Mountain Road near Woodruff Rd, 864.412.3323 (one seater karts).

faq.q: What are the Greenville track hours?
faq.a: Monday closed, Tuesday-Thursday 3-9pm, Friday 2-10pm, Saturday 12pm-12am, Sunday 12pm-9pm.
